subject: freelancers
one_liner: Rent a freelancer by the night. Return them with the original number of opinions.
brand_voice_notes: A roadside motel managed by a procurement department. Treat freelancers as short-term accommodation without ever explaining the metaphor. Plain hospitality language, exact fees, sincere house rules. No winks, no startup triumph, no em dashes in visible copy.

hero.h1: A little room in someone’s calendar.
hero.sub: Book a freelancer by the night. Browse entire creatives, private developers and shared strategists. Please leave them as you found them.

features.title: Entire person. No other clients.
features.blurb: Reserve exclusive use of one freelancer. Their other clients are relocated to a comparable freelancer up to 40 miles away.

features.title: Self check-in, even at 2 a.m.
features.blurb: Our AI turns your brief into a six-digit access code. Enter it in their inbox. The scope of work will be in the lockbox.

features.title: A cleaning fee for the brief.

demo_screen_concept: A search results page for freelancers listed as rentals. Eight listing cards with photos, star ratings and nightly rates, filterable by stay type (Entire, Private, Shared), Superhost and Instant Book, with live search and sorting. Clicking a card opens a listing sheet with amenities, house rules, a nights stepper and a price breakdown that adds a cleaning fee, a guest service fee and an unpaid revision deposit. Reserving flips the listing to Booked and returns a host reply. A neon VACANCY sign sits in the header; its NO segment is burned out and never lights, however many hosts you book.

design_direction.style: Poolside modernism with Art Deco motel lettering. Flat pale pool-blue surfaces, pine green ink, coral neon tubing, quiet rounded booking controls and wide rectangular photography. The vacancy sign is the single expressive object; the rest behaves like a considered hospitality marketplace.
design_direction.archetype: Marketplace / Directory from ui-ux-pro-max: search-led hero, photo listings, amenities, guest register, reservation tariffs. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS adapted to the pipeline.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 200ms control feedback and dialog entry only. No continuous blinking or decorative motion. Reduced-motion removes transitions. The NO tube remains unlit in every state.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left-aligned 44/56 split: large open Poiret One headline and a search-style demo link alongside a wide courtyard photograph. A pine front-desk header carries the coral vacancy sign. The image caption is below the photograph, never over the subject. Mobile stacks copy above image. Amenities use roomy horizontal rows; testimonials form a guest register; tariffs use a booking ledger.
design_direction.design_review: Rejected the automatic liquid-glass recommendation: glass blur has no role in a roadside lodging directory. Chose a custom pool palette and the library Art Deco pairing; neither the style/palette/font tuple nor the font pair repeats the seven entries preceding 2026-11-01.

images.rationale: Recovery rebuild: no image generation authorized or performed. Reuse the existing hero courtyard photo and three existing freelancer portraits. Hero appears on the pitch and one listing; the three portraits supply the remaining listings, with repeat photos identifying the same host offered under different stay types. Testimonial headshots skipped; the guest register uses names and titles. Four original assets preserved byte-for-byte.
images.source: Existing unpublished entry assets inherited at start of recovery. Original saved generation prompts and attempt counts retained; this run did not independently observe those generations.

items.prompt: Editorial color photograph, 1960s Palm Springs motel courtyard in hard desert sun. One tired freelance worker in their thirties sits fully dressed on a white lounge chair beside a turquoise pool, laptop on knees, staring ahead with deadpan resignation. Pink stucco wall #F8D3C5 with a concrete breeze-block screen behind, agave plants in deep green #0E5C4F, a small orange-red #E8532B towel. Wide composition with the subject right of center. Kodachrome film look, natural skin, slightly faded. Strictly no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signage lettering, no brand marks on the laptop, no rendered UI screens; laptop lid faces away or is plain.

items.judge_verdict: Accepted on local visual inspection: correct freelance subject, compatible pool/pine/pink photographic palette, no visible text or watermark; natural skin and plausible motel setting.
